props.name: align
props.description:
Alignment of the content along the trigger edge: `'start'` and `'end'` line up the content
edge with the matching trigger edge, `'center'` centers it. Combines with `placement`.

props.name: children
props.description: Composed trigger and content primitives.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description:
Delay in milliseconds between the pointer or focus leaving the trigger and content and
closing; re-entering within the delay keeps it open. Only used with `openOnHover`.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Whether pressing Escape closes the content. When `false` the key press is blocked, the content
stays open and `onClosePrevented` is called.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description:
Whether a pointer press outside the content and its trigger, or focus moving outside, closes
the content (focus does not dismiss hover-opened popovers). When `false` the attempt is blocked,
the content stays open and `onClosePrevented` is called.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled. Ignored while `open` is set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether trigger interactions and content rendering are disabled.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description:
Element (or accessor resolving to one) that receives focus after the content closes, or
`false` to skip the close-time focus restore. Defaults to the trigger. An accessor that
returns `undefined` restores no focus. Focus is not restored when a non-modal content is
dismissed by an outside press or focus move, since focus already went elsewhere. Hover-opened
popovers (`openOnHover`) default to not restoring focus.
examples:
import { Button, Popover } from 'moraine'

<Popover finalFocus={() => document.getElementById('search') ?? undefined}>
  <Popover.Trigger as={Button}>Filters</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>Filter options</Popover.Content>
</Popover>

props.name: flip
props.description:
Whether the content moves to another side when the preferred `placement` does not fit in the
viewport. `false` keeps the side fixed. A string is a space-delimited list of fallback
placements tried in order, each `top`, `right`, `bottom` or `left`, optionally suffixed with
`-start` or `-end`; any other entry throws an error.
examples:
import { Button, Popover } from 'moraine'

<Popover placement="bottom" flip="top bottom-end">
  <Popover.Trigger as={Button}>Details</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>More information</Popover.Content>
</Popover>

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Whether the content stays in the DOM while closed, hidden and marked with `data-closed`, for
example to measure it or keep its state. Has no effect while `disabled`.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the content.

props.name: id
props.description:
Unique identifier used to derive the content id, which becomes `<id>-content`. Generated when
omitted.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Whether the content traps focus, hides outside content from assistive technology, prevents
the native default action of outside pointer events, and locks body scroll.
This is enabled only when Popover.Content composes Popover.Close; otherwise the Popover
remains non-modal so assistive-technology users retain a dismissal route, and a DEV
warning is logged. Outside and Escape dismissal remain controlled by `closeOnOutsideClick`
and `closeOnEscape`.

props.name: onClosePrevented
props.description:
Called with no arguments when Escape (`closeOnEscape` is `false`) or an outside press or focus
move (`closeOnOutsideClick` is `false`) tried to close the content and was blocked.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next open state when an interaction (trigger press, hover or focus delay,
Escape, outside press) requests a change. It is not called when `open` is changed from outside,
and it does not apply the change itself when `open` is controlled: update `open` in the handler.
examples:
import { Button, Popover } from 'moraine'
import { createSignal } from 'solid-js'

const [open, setOpen] = createSignal(false)

<Popover open={open()} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <Popover.Trigger as={Button}>Details</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>More information</Popover.Content>
</Popover>

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled open state. Pair it with `onOpenChange`; leave it `undefined` to let the component
manage its own state (see `defaultOpen`). `disabled` forces the content closed regardless.

props.name: openDelay
props.description:
Delay in milliseconds between pointer enter or trigger focus and opening. Only used with
`openOnHover`.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description:
Opens the popover when a mouse pointer enters the trigger or the trigger receives keyboard
focus, and closes it `closeDelay` ms after the pointer or focus leaves the trigger and content.
Clicking the trigger then only opens it instead of toggling. Touch hover is ignored. Outside
focus no longer dismisses the content, and focus is not restored to the trigger on close
unless `finalFocus` is set.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description: Minimum padding in pixels between the content and the viewport edge.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Side of the trigger the content opens on. The rendered side can differ when `flip` moves it to
fit the viewport; read it from `data-side` on the content.

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Whether body scroll is locked while the content is present. A modal content always locks it.

props.name: shift
props.description:
Offset in pixels along the trigger edge (horizontal for `top` and `bottom` placements,
vertical for `left` and `right`), added to the position given by `align`.

props.name: slide
props.description:
Whether the content slides along the trigger edge (horizontally for `top` and `bottom`
placements, vertically for `left` and `right`) to stay inside the viewport, keeping
`overflowPadding` from the edge, instead of overflowing.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label and visual content.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this trigger is disabled.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.
